caption: The drawing features a single metallic bell suspended from a supporting frame. The bell is centrally positioned and is a muted brass or bronze color with some areas showing darker and lighter patches, likely indicating wear or texture. The supporting frame consists of two curved arms that rise from a base on either side, arching upwards and meeting above the bell to hold it. The frame has a rusty brown and reddish hue, with an uneven texture suggesting corrosion or weathering. The clapper of the bell is visible at the bottom center, depicted in a dark, almost black shade. The background is an off-white or light beige color, and there are no other objects or elements visible. The artist’s signature, "Edith Townes," appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Ship's Bell
